text: The Fed is now signaling a potential rate hike with inflation stuck at 3.4% and cuts pushed to 2027 — this means borrowing costs stay high longer, which is especially painful for cash-burning, unprofitable companies in your portfolio like QBTS, IONQ, and RGTI.

QBTS is down 35% with no earnings, 22% short interest, and a cash-burning model — in a rising-rate environment where unprofitable companies get punished hardest, reduce this position to limit further damage.
Micron has extraordinary relative strength, nearly 49% revenue growth, and a PE of just 6.9 — this is your strongest fundamental holding and worth adding to on any pullback.
Google at a PE of 23.6 with 15% revenue growth and insider buying is one of the most reasonably priced quality names in your portfolio — worth adding as a defensive growth anchor.
